# Samples with available Bionano OGM data
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# ---- Load Required Libraries ----
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(UpSetR)
```

```{r}
# ===============================
# Load cohort file
# ===============================
df <- read_csv(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/Grant/pILC_cohort.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  trim_ws = TRUE,
  na = c("", "NA")
)

# ===============================
# Clean column names
# ===============================
colnames(df) <- trimws(colnames(df))
colnames(df) <- make.names(colnames(df), unique = TRUE)

# ===============================
# Expected platform order
# ===============================
platform_order <- c("OGM", "RNAseq", "IMPACTseq", "WGS", "VisiumHD", "WES", "Xenium")

# Check required columns
missing_cols <- setdiff(c("Sample", platform_order), colnames(df))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Missing columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
}

# Keep only relevant columns
df <- df %>%
  select(Sample, all_of(platform_order))

# ===============================
# Keep only real sample rows
# Sample must start with TP
# ===============================
df <- df %>%
  mutate(Sample = trimws(as.character(Sample))) %>%
  filter(grepl("^TP", Sample)) %>%
  distinct(Sample, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ===============================
# Convert Y -> 1, all else -> 0
# ===============================
df_binary <- df %>%
  mutate(across(-Sample, ~ ifelse(trimws(as.character(.)) == "Y", 1, 0))) %>%
  mutate(across(-Sample, ~ replace_na(., 0)))

# UpSet input
df_upset <- df_binary %>%
  select(-Sample) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# ===============================
# Print summary
# Order platforms by ascending sample count
# low sample count first, high sample count last
# ===============================
platform_order <- names(sort(colSums(df_upset), decreasing = TRUE))

cat("Platform order (ascending by sample count):\n")
print(platform_order)

cat("\nSamples per modality:\n")
print(sort(colSums(df_upset), decreasing = TRUE))

# ---- Print ----
upset(
  df_upset,
  sets = platform_order,
  nsets = length(platform_order),
  keep.order = TRUE,
  order.by = "freq",
  decreasing = c(TRUE, FALSE),
  main.bar.color = "steelblue",
  sets.bar.color = "gray35",
  text.scale = c(2.0, 2.0, 1.7, 1.5, 2.0, 1.8),
  mb.ratio = c(0.65, 0.35)
)

# ---- Save Plot ----
# ===============================
# Save PNG
# ===============================
png(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/Grant/upset_plot.png",
  width = 2200,
  height = 1600,
  res = 220
)

upset(
  df_upset,
  sets = platform_order,
  nsets = length(platform_order),
  keep.order = TRUE,
  order.by = "freq",
  decreasing = c(TRUE, FALSE),
  main.bar.color = "steelblue",
  sets.bar.color = "gray35",
  text.scale = c(2.0, 2.0, 1.7, 1.5, 2.0, 1.8),
  mb.ratio = c(0.65, 0.35)
)

dev.off()

# ---- Save PDF ----
pdf(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/Grant/upset_plot.pdf",
  width = 14,
  height = 10
)

upset(
  df_upset,
  sets = platform_order,
  nsets = length(platform_order),
  keep.order = TRUE,
  order.by = "freq",
  decreasing = c(TRUE, FALSE),
  main.bar.color = "steelblue",
  sets.bar.color = "gray35",
  text.scale = c(2.0, 2.0, 1.7, 1.5, 2.0, 1.8),
  mb.ratio = c(0.65, 0.35)
)

dev.off()
```
